chart.name: # Active buckets

noDataOptions.noDataMessage: Currently, no data is available for this chart. This chart requires the S3 Bucket metrics enabled in your S3 bucket.

chart.programText:
A = data('BytesUploaded', filter=filter('stat', 'sum') and filter('namespace', 'AWS/S3'), rollup='rate').sum(by=['BucketName']).sum(over='1h').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('BytesDownloaded', filter=filter('stat', 'sum') and filter('namespace', 'AWS/S3')).sum(by=['BucketName']).sum(over='1h').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A+B).publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (A).count().publish(label='D', enable=False)
E = (B).count().publish(label='E', enable=False)
F = (C).count().publish(label='F', enable=False)
G = (D+E-F).publish(label='G')
